Im Auftrag unser Partnerunternehmen in München suchen wir Sie als „IT Projektmanager Software Implementierung (m/w/d)“.
Aufgaben
Als IT Projektmanager (m/w/d) leiten und steuern Sie internationale Kundenprojekte zur Implementierung von Softwarelösungen im Bereich Instandhaltung und Flottenmanagement
Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinieren Sie die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden, internen Fachbereichen und externen Dienstleistern
Sie erfassen und analysieren Kundenanforderungen und überführen diese in strukturierte technische Spezifikationen und Arbeitspakete
Darüber hinaus übernehmen Sie das Projektcontrolling inklusive Meilensteinplanung, Risikoanalyse sowie das aktive Gegensteuern bei Abweichungen
Zusätzlich verantworten Sie das Stakeholder-Reporting und stellen eine transparente Kommunikation gegenüber Kunden und Management sicher
Qualifikation
Grundlage bildet ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation; alternativ eine IT-Ausbildung mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung im Projektmanagement
Sie verfügen über fundiertes technisches Verständnis von Softwarearchitekturen, Schnittstellen (APIs) und Entwicklungsprozessen zur sicheren Steuerung technischer Dienstleister
Idealerweise bringen Sie Berufserfahrung als IT-Projektmanager (m/w/d), Projektleiter (m/w/d), Product Owner (m/w/d) oder IT-Consultant (m/w/d) mit
Zusätzlich sind Kenntnisse im Umfeld Instandhaltung, Werkstattprozesse oder Flottenmanagement von Vorteil
Wichtig sind sehr gute Kenntnisse in klassischen und agilen Projektmanagementmethoden sowie sicherer Umgang mit Tools wie Jira, Confluence oder MS Project; verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab

Work-Life-Balance : Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten im Gleitzeitmodell
Krisensicherheit beim Marktführer : Kaum ein Unternehmen bietet eine derartige Sicherheit wie dieses
Entwicklung : Firmenintern gibt es zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
Vielseitigkeit : Freuen Sie sich auf spannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld
Teamspirit : Sie erwarten flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege sowie eine wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit

Job Description Job Title: Associate, IT Project Manager Department Name: MIS Effective Date: 2.13.2026 Reports to (title): Director, IT # of Direct Reports: 0 # Indirect Reports: 0 Individual Contributor: XX Yes No Full Time/Part Time: Full time # Hours Per Week: 40-55 Average Work Schedule: Monday – Friday 8:00 – 5:00 Location: Remote Job Summary: Associate IT Project Manager will support and partially lead delivery across multiple IT initiatives, including a major Salesforce implementation over the next 18 months.

This role partners closely, technical leads, and business stakeholders to coordinate workstreams, maintain project structure, and manage portions of the project lifecycle. This role requires one to be highly organized, collaborative, and proactive.

This role reports to the Director of Information Technology and will be poised to grow into full project ownership.

Scope of job: The Associate IT Project Manager supports and partially leads delivery across multiple IT initiatives using a hybrid Agile/Waterfall approach, with near‑term focus on a major Salesforce implementation over the next 18 months.

The role coordinates assigned workstreams (e.g., requirements, testing, training), maintains core project artifacts (schedules, RAID logs, resource trackers), monitors risks and dependencies, facilitates smaller cross‑functional sessions, drafts executive-ready updates, and contributes to SIT/UAT, cutover, and hyper‑care readiness.

The Associate Project Manager improves templates and processes, helps translate technical updates into business terms, and partners closely with senior PMs, technical leads, and business stakeholders to ensure predictable delivery and clean operational handoffs. Duties/Responsibilities: Project Delivery (Hybrid Methodology)
· Assist in managing IT projects from planning through closure using a hybrid Agile/Waterfall approach.
· Contribute to developing project artifacts such as schedules, scope summaries, RAID logs, and resource trackers.
· Maintain and update integrated project plans under guidance from senior PMs.
· Monitor risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate appropriately and recommend preliminary mitigation options.
· Support delivery controls including weekly status reporting, action tracking, and change documentation. Salesforce Implementation Support & Partial Ownership
· Coordinate assigned Salesforce workstreams (e.g., requirements documentation, configuration tracking, testing coordination).
· Support data readiness, migration planning, and integration tracking by gathering updates and maintaining structured documentation.
· Assist with SIT/UAT planning, defect tracking, and training logistics.
· Contribute to cutover and go-live readiness planning by preparing checklists and consolidating readiness inputs.
· Maintain organized repositories of deliverables and help ensure alignment across internal teams. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication
· Facilitate smaller working sessions and assist senior PMs with larger cross-functional meetings.
· Prepare agendas, meeting notes, follow-up actions, and status updates.
· Draft executive-ready summaries and dashboards for review by senior PMs.
· Help translate technical updates into clear, business-friendly communication. Quality, Readiness & Operational Handoff
· Support testing coordination, defect triage, and validation cycles.
· Assist with cutover planning, go-live checklists, and hyper-care coordination.
· Help prepare operational handoff materials including documentation, support models, and runbooks. Process & Continuous Improvement
· Maintain and improve project templates, trackers, and documentation standards.
· Participate in lessons-learned sessions and help identify opportunities to improve delivery processes.
· Recommend practical improvements to streamline coordination and increase predictability. Required Skills/Abilities:
· Working knowledge of project management concepts (scope, schedule, risks, dependencies).
· Strong communication and organizational skills with growing confidence in stakeholder engagement.
· Proficiency with Smartsheet/MS Project, Jira/Confluence, and Microsoft 365 (Teams/SharePoint).
· Preferred: exposure to Salesforce projects, data migration, or testing workstreams; interest in pursuing PMP or similar certification. Education, Experience, and/or Certifications:
· Minimum of 3 years of experience in IT project coordination, junior project management, or PMO support.
· Experience supporting enterprise application or infrastructure projects. Competencies: Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up-to 30 pounds at times. Must be able to see, hear, and listen, to effectively communicate. Must be able to travel up to 25% to El Paso Originally posted on Himalayas

This position is for the Junction City, KS as their duty location. Provides comprehensive operational oversight and coordination for Junction City, Iola, and Lawrence VA Clinics, ensuring efficient day-to-day functioning and continuous improvement of clinical and administrative operations.

Evaluates outpatient service delivery models and develops recommendations to improve access, efficiency, and patient experience within assigned clinics and market areas.

Supports the delivery of high-quality, accessible, cost-effective health care services by coordinating resources, workflow processes, access initiatives, and support functions across multiple clinical disciplines to promote efficient clinic operations, timely access to care, and effective utilization of available resources. .

Leads and supports advanced analytical studies to evaluate clinical workload trends, patient flow, scheduling practices, and capacity management across assigned clinics. Uses data-driven methodologies to identify inefficiencies, forecast demand, and recommend organizational improvements.

Optimizes provider and care team scheduling by assessing clinic grid utilization, supply demand alignment, face to face and virtual visit distributions, staffing acuity, and clinical productivity indicators. Evaluates the impact of Community Care referrals on internal capacity, access to care, patient wait times, and care continuity.

Collaborates with clinical leaders to rebalance services between VA-delivered care, virtual modalities, and purchased care when appropriate.

Leads efforts to improve patient workflows by partnering with Primary Care, Mental Health, Specialty Care, and Nursing leadership to evaluate room utilization, care team composition, visit modality mix, appointment cycle times, and bottlenecks impacting throughput.

Develop operational solutions such as standardized workflows, enhanced scheduling procedures, process redesign, escalation pathways, and care coordination practices to enhance access and patient experience. Identifies and implements improvements to optimize clinic management processes and access strategies.

Standardizes, implements, and sustains key operational and business processes, including scheduling practices, to support efficient clinic operations and enhance the Veteran experience Incorporates remote healthcare considerations, including telehealth demand, virtual care readiness, space requirements for telehealth operations, and staffing support, to ensure seamless integration of virtual modalities into clinic operations.

Conducts analyses of telehealth utilization patterns, no show rates, broadband limitations, and patient adoption trends to support operational decision-making and service delivery planning.

Administers management reporting systems and dashboards to support data informed decision making related to organizational performance, staffing models, access metrics, quality indicators, and workload distribution.

Develops and coordinates quality assurance and performance improvement activities ensuring compliance with accrediting and regulatory bodies (e.g., Joint Commission, OIG, CARF). The HSS measures and assesses clinical business activities with an emphasis on improving clinical product line performance.

The HSS is responsible for regularly presenting key management indicators to the Executive Staff. Integrates administrative services-including Finance, HR, Acquisition, Facilities, Environmental of Care, and Health Administration Service-in support of clinic goals and market objectives.

Resolves complex operational, personnel, and cross service issues that impact patient care, staff performance, and organizational effectiveness. Provides leadership during change management initiatives, operational disruptions, and emergent contingencies that affect clinic operations.

The incumbent collaborates closely with key clinical leadership officials as an impartial facilitator in addressing disagreements related to scheduling practices, workload distribution, resource prioritization, and workflow redesign.

Employs conflict resolution strategies, mediation techniques, and interest-based problem solving to ensure concerns are addressed objectively, respectfully, and in alignment with EKHCS policies and organizational values.

To qualify for the GS 0671 occupational series, applicants MUST possess one of the following: (for positions above GS-5): Progressively responsible analytical or administrative, or clinical management or supervisory experience in the health care field.

This work may have been performed in an operating health care facility or a higher organizational echelon with advisory or directional authority over such facilities.

Work must have involved a close working relationship with facility managers and analysis and/or coordination of administrative, clinical, or other service activities, and provided knowledge of the following: Missions, organizations, programs, and requirements of health care delivery systems; Regulations and standards of various regulatory and credentialing groups; and Government-wide, agency, and facility systems and requirements in various administrative areas such as budget, personnel, and procurement.

In addition to the individual occupational requirement, you must meet the specialized experience for the position as well:GS-12 Specialized Experience: You must have one year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade GS-11 in the normal line of progression for the occupation in the organization.

Demonstrated mastery in applying analytical and evaluative methods and techniques to issues or studies concerning the efficiency and effectiveness of agency and program operations.

Expert knowledge of pertinent laws, regulations, policies and precedents, major issues, program goals and objectives, work processes, and administrative operations which affect the administration of GBO program and committee functions.

Mastery of VHA organization structure and operations to support VHA-wide assessments to improve the VHA system for health care. Expert knowledge of missions, organizations, programs, and requirements of health care delivery systems in general and in the country at large.

Excellent interpersonal skills to facilitate and coordinate vast needs for communications and information, between and among the stakeholders, including the Department, VHACO, VISNs, facilities and non-VA groups.

Job Details Under general direction of an Engineering Project Director, the Engineering Project Manager is responsible for one or more components of an overall project.

This role is suitable for an experienced Project Manager with an Engineering background (industrial Engineering is preferred). Projects relate to the design, build, and improvement of distribution facilities and processes. Assignments may span one or more projects that can range in size, complexity, and cross functional involvement.

Typical scope of management ranges from less than $1MM to greater than $20MM per project.

Works closely with Project Director to assist in the development of a project charter outlining project design and/or implementation requirements.
Assists in the preparation of capital expenditure requests for projects.
Manages assigned scope according to the project charter including vendor selection and vendor management from RFP through design, installation, and final invoicing.
Manages overall onsite build or installation coordination with internal and external partners.
Manages development and management of project budget
Project elements may include material handling equipment, warehouse, and business systems, building construction or modification and other equipment and services typically found within a distribution environment.

May be assigned multiple areas of scope.

Jobbeschreibung
Göhler GmbH & Co. KG ist seit über 75 Jahren Spezialist für Anlagen rund um wassergefährdende Flüssigkeiten, technische Gase und Medienversorgung. Mit unserem Know-how aus Planung, Bau, Inbetriebnahme und Service komplexer Anlagen unterstützen wir Kunden aus Industrie, KRITIS und sicherheitsrelevanten Bereichen.

Für den Aufbau unseres Geschäftsfeldes Defence & KRITIS suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Ausschreibungen und Bedarfe identifiziert, Projekte akquiriert und diese von der Anbahnung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung begleitet.
Ihre Aufgaben
Akquise und Ausschreibungen: Sie analysieren öffentliche Ausschreibungen im Defence‑ und KRITIS‑Beschaffungswesen, pflegen Kontakte zu Beschaffungsämtern und erstellen Angebote. Dabei berücksichtigen Sie technische Spezifikationen, Termin‑ und Budgetvorgaben sowie vergaberechtliche Anforderungen.
Projektmanagement: Nach Auftragserhalt verantworten Sie die Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle von Projekten. Dazu gehören die Koordination interner und externer Gewerke (z. B. Mechanik, Elektrotechnik, Stahlbau usw.), die Sicherstellung von Qualität, Kosten und Terminen sowie das Risiko‑ und Änderungsmanagement .
Schnittstelle und Kommunikation: Als zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in stimmen Sie sich mit Kund:innen, Behörden, Lieferanten und internen Fachabteilungen ab . Sie sorgen für einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss und begleiten Bemusterungen, Tests, Abnahmen und Inbetriebnahmen. Die Dokumentation stimmen Sie verantwortlich mit unserer Dokumentationsabteilung und externen Partnern ab.
Dokumentation und Compliance: Sie erstellen Projektpläne, Berichte und Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Die Einhaltung von Sicherheits‑, Gesundheits‑ und Umweltschutzbestimmungen sowie die Qualitäts‑ und Zulassungsanforderungen der Aufsichtsbehörden im Defence‑ und KRITIS‑Umfeld haben Sie dabei stets im Blick.
Stellenanforderungen
Abgeschlossenes technisches oder wirtschaftliches Studium (z. B. Verfahrenstechnik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen),

Die Abteilung Automobiltechnik der Technischen Berufsschule Zürich TBZ ist das Kompetenzzentrum für die Aus- und Weiterbildung der Automobil- und Carrosserieberufe. Rund 600 Lernende werden in der Grundbildung unterrichtet, ergänzt durch ein Weiterbildungsangebot mit etwa 40 Studierenden in Lehrgängen zur Vorbereitung auf Berufsprüfungen, höhere Fachprüfungen und Zertifikatsabschlüsse.
Auf Beginn des Frühlingssemesters 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung suchen wir eine engagierte und führungsstarke Persönlichkeit als Abteilungsleitung Automobiltechnik. Die Funktion wird im Co-Leitungsmodell wahrgenommen. Gemeinsam mit Ihrer Führungspartnerin tragen Sie die Gesamtverantwortung für die Abteilung und gestalten deren strategische, personelle, pädagogische und organisatorische Weiterentwicklung.
### Ihre Aufgaben ###
Zu Ihren Kernaufgaben gehören insbesondere die personelle Führung, Förderung und Entwicklung der rund 40 Lehrpersonen, die Sicherstellung eines qualitativ hochstehenden und verlässlichen Schulbetriebs, sowie die Planung, Steuerung und Verantwortung der finanziellen und personellen Ressourcen.
Ausserdem sind Sie dafür zuständig, die Bildungsangebote und den Unterricht in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Anspruchsgruppen der Berufsbildung weiterzuentwickeln. Die Pflege und der Ausbau der Zusammenarbeit mit Verbänden, Betrieben, ÜK-Zentren und weiteren Partnern sowie die aktive Mitwirkung in der erweiterten Schulleitung der TBZ und Mitgestaltung der Schulentwicklung runden Ihr Aufgabengebiet ab.
### Ihr Profil ###
Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Unterrichts- und Führungserfahrung auf der Sekundarstufe II und bringen idealerweise ein breites Netzwerk in der Automobilbranche mit. Sie verstehen es, Menschen zu führen, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen und Veränderungen zielgerichtet umzusetzen.
Ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (FH, ETH oder Universität) in einem für die Automobiltechnik relevanten Fachbereich oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung, gehört genauso zu Ihrem Ausbildungsportfolio wie ein Lehrdiplom für Berufsfachschulen (EHB, PHZH oder gleichwertige Qualifikation).
Eine Schulleitungsausbildung haben Sie entweder schon abgeschlossen oder wären bereit, diese zeitnah zu absolvieren.
Ausgewiesene Führungskompetenzen sowie ein hohes Mass an Kommunikations- und Kooperationsfähigkeit sind ebenfalls entscheidende Kompetenzen, die Sie mitbringen.
Wir suchen eine integre, entscheidungsfreudige und unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, vernetzt handelt und die Weiterentwicklung der Berufsbildung aktiv mitgestaltet.
### Unser Angebot ###
Es erwartet Sie eine grosse und etablierte Berufsfachschule mit klaren Strukturen, hoher Fachkompetenz und gleichzeitig erheblichem Gestaltungsspielraum.

We are currently seeking a **Treasury Manager** to join our Global Treasury team as part of the **Funding (****External & Internal Funding****)** team in Geneva.
This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to funding and capital markets transactions, capital structure optimization, intercompany financing, and strategic treasury initiatives within a global NYSE/SIX-listed company, while working closely with senior Treasury and Finance leadership, including the Group Treasurer and CFO.
This role is ideally suited for early-career finance professionals seeking to transition into a high-visibility corporate finance and treasury role with significant international exposure and long-term growth opportunities.
**A Typical Day as a Treasury** **Manager, External & Internal Funding**
As a Treasury Manager within the External & Internal Funding team, you will:
* Support treasury and corporate finance activities through financial analysis, reporting, and financial modelling.
* Assist in the structuring, execution, and monitoring of intercompany loans, guarantees, and other treasury-related transactions.
* Support intercompany funding strategies, dividend repatriation initiatives, and cash repatriation activities across the Group.
* Monitor affiliate capital structures and support funding recommendations to optimize financing, liquidity, and balance sheet efficiency as well as to mitigate any country risks and financial risks.
* Prepare presentations and decision materials for Finance leadership, the CFO, Finance Committee, Executive Committee, and Board of Directors.
* Support the analysis and execution of Group financing opportunities, including loans, credit facilities, debt issuances, and other debt-like instruments.
* Contribute to funding, capital structure, liquidity management, and refinancing projects across the Group.
* Support analyses related to credit ratings, banking services, and financial counterparties, including materials for interactions with rating agencies, lenders, and core banking partners.
* Maintain and enhance treasury models, dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Monitor financial markets, interest rates, foreign exchange markets, credit markets, and macroeconomic developments.
* Collaborate closely with Treasury, Tax, Accounting, FP&A, Investor Relations, Legal, external auditors, banks, and local finance teams globally.
* Support treasury-related analyses involving tax, accounting, and audit considerations impacting financing and funding structures.
* Drive treasury process improvements, automation initiatives, and system enhancements.
* Prepare recurring Treasury deliverables, including WACC analyses, dividend proposals and payment processes, credit metrics, financing reviews, and materials for management and governance committees.
* Support the maintenance and integrity of the Treasury Management System and related reporting platforms.

* Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
**Experience**
* 2-3 years of relevant experience in Investment Banking, Corporate Treasury, Treasury Advisory, Consulting, Transaction services, Audit, Consulting, Corporate Finance, or a related field.
* Exposure to financial markets, funding, treasury, or capital markets activities is a strong asset.
* Experience working in a multinational or international environment is a plus.
**Technical Skills**
* Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Financial modelling, valuation methodologies, credit metrics and capital structure analysis experience is a strong asset.
* Experience with Treasury Management Systems, Bloomberg, SAP, Power BI, or similar financial platforms is a plus.
* Ability to translate complex financial information into clear recommendations and management presentations.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work with large and complex datasets.
* Strong interest in finance, financial markets, and macroeconomic developments.
* Exposure to corporate finance, treasury, capital markets, funding strategies, credit ratings, and debt financing is a plus.
* Accounting knowledge and understanding of financial statements are strong assets.
**Soft Skills**
* Dynamic, hands-on, and proactive mindset.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Quick learner with a genuine interest in building a long-term career within Treasury and Corporate Finance.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Collaborative team player with an international mindset.
* High attention to detail and sound professional judgement.
* Eagerness to continuously learn and expand treasury expertise.
**Languages**
* Fluency in English required.

Remote, Full-Time (Some Travel) Exempt Reports to: Director of VDC / Operations
About Ayoroa Simmons
Ayoroa Simmons is one of the most trusted reality capture and BIM firms in the Eastern United States, with a client roster that includes some of the largest AEC organizations in the country and the U.S. Department of Defense. For over a decade, we have delivered surveying, laser scanning, Scan to BIM, and BIM/VDC services as a fully integrated offering, giving project teams the accurate existing-conditions data they need to design, build, and manage with confidence.
With a 35+ person team and a track record on complex institutional, healthcare, and infrastructure projects, we bring the scale and precision standards that this work demands. Ayoroa Simmons is an established firm at a growth inflection point, and we're building toward the clients who need us most.

Ayoroa Simmons is seeking a Senior BIM/VDC Project Manager to lead model-based coordination and digital delivery across complex AEC projects, while supporting client relationships, strategic pursuits, and firm growth. The ideal candidate brings technical credibility and client-facing leadership, managing BIM/VDC execution, advising project teams, and representing the firm in pursuits.
This is a fully remote role with some travel expected.

BIM/VDC project leadership
Align BIM/VDC scope, schedule, budget, and staffing with overall project goals.
Lead BIM/VDC execution from pursuit and preconstruction through construction and closeout, including BIM Execution Plans, model coordination strategies, and deliverable schedules.
Serve as primary BIM/VDC point of contact for owners, design teams, contractors, trade partners, and internal staff.
Establish QA/QC protocols for models, documentation, and coordination milestones; identify risks early and recommend mitigation strategies.
Support and guide Project Leads in running multidisciplinary coordination meetings, clash detection workflows, constructability reviews, and issue resolution, staying actively engaged while empowering Project Leads to own day-to-day meeting leadership.
Client relationships & pursuits
Build and maintain relationships with clients, contractors, design partners, and industry stakeholders; identify opportunities for new work, expanded services, and follow-on assignments.
Support go/no-go decisions, capture planning, proposal development, and win strategy for BIM/VDC-related opportunities.
Participate in client meetings, shortlist presentations, and pursuit strategy sessions; contribute technical content and value propositions.
Serve as a trusted advisor, translating client goals into BIM/VDC scopes, work plans, and deliverables.
Manage assigned consultants and trade partners, including coordination of their scope, project invoicing, and billing.
Represent Ayoroa Simmons at industry events and conferences; partner with principals and marketing to align VDC capabilities with firm growth.
Technology, standards & process improvement
Develop and maintain BIM/VDC standards, templates, workflows, and best practices across projects and offices.
Evaluate and select BIM/VDC software, including Autodesk, Bluebeam, and comparable platforms, to advance leading industry workflows and production.
Drive innovation in Revit and coordination workflows, extending the firm's established leadership in scanning and reality capture; implement automation, dashboards, and emerging technologies (4D scheduling, digital twins, reality capture, prefabrication).
Train and mentor project teams on coordination processes, tools, and digital delivery expectations.
Team leadership & mentorship
Supervise, mentor, and develop BIM/VDC coordinators, specialists, and modelers.
Provide technical guidance to project managers, discipline leads, and field teams.
Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment; promote knowledge sharing across projects and markets.

Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related field; equivalent experience welcomed.
8+ years in BIM, VDC, construction technology, or digital project delivery, including 3+ years leading BIM/VDC on complex AEC projects.
Demonstrated experience supporting client relationships, pursuits, proposals, or presentations.
Advanced proficiency with Revit, Navisworks, Autodesk Forma, and similar platforms.
Experience developing BIM Execution Plans, clash detection workflows, and model standards.
Strong communication, facilitation, and presentation skills; ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders.

Experience in healthcare, commercial, higher education, infrastructure, or mission-critical sectors.
Established client or industry network in the Eastern U.S. AEC market.
Experience with 4D/5D integration, digital twins, laser scanning, reality capture, or prefabrication workflows.
Familiarity with Power BI, automation, scripting, or model-based analytics.
Experience with project scheduling (Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project).
Professional certifications: CM-BIM, PMP, DBIA, LEED AP, or Autodesk certification.
Key competencies
BIM/VDC technical leadership · Client relationship management · Project delivery accountability · Constructability judgment · Pursuit & proposal support · Team mentorship · Process improvement · Data-driven decision-making
Success measures
On-time delivery of BIM/VDC scope, milestones, and model standards.
Reduction in coordination issues, RFIs, rework, and field conflicts.
Client satisfaction, repeat work, and new opportunities identified or supported.
Proposal shortlist and win contributions; revenue or backlog influenced.
Adoption of improved VDC workflows and development of BIM/VDC team members.

Chef de Projet Réalité Augmentée F1 (Genève - Suisse)
Rejoignez la FIA et dirigez un programme pionnier de technologie de sécurité.
En tant que Chef de Projet Réalité Augmentée F1 au sein du Département Technique de la FIA, vous dirigerez un programme stratégique pluriannuel explorant comment les technologies de Réalité Augmentée et d-Affichage Tête Haute pourraient améliorer la sécurité des pilotes et la conscience situationnelle, notamment dans des conditions de visibilité réduite.
Vous agirez en tant que leader technique du programme et intégrateur de systèmes, coordonnant des fournisseurs spécialisés, des partenaires de recherche, des équipes de Formule 1 et des parties prenantes internes à la FIA. Ce rôle ne correspond pas à une gestion de projet traditionnelle. Il requiert des connaissances techniques pour challenger les propositions d-ingénierie, gérer les risques d-intégration et piloter des décisions techniques complexes.
Ce nouveau poste permanent à temps plein est basé de préférence à Genève. Londres peut également être envisagé.

Direction technique du programme
* Définir et posséder la feuille de route technique pluriannuelle, les phases de développement, les jalons et les livrables.
* Structurer le programme autour des technologies clés, y compris les affichages casque et visière, les solutions HUD optiques, les capteurs, le positionnement du véhicule, le traitement des données et la fusion de capteurs.
* Diriger le programme depuis l-évaluation technologique et la preuve de concept jusqu-au développement de prototypes, à l-intégration et aux tests.
* Maintenir une gouvernance efficace via la gestion des risques, des dépendances, des ressources et des jalons.
Intégration des systèmes et coordination technique
* Agir en tant qu-intégrateur technique des systèmes électroniques embarqués, capteurs, systèmes de communication, solutions de traitement des données et équipements du pilote.
* Traduire les objectifs de sécurité et opérationnels en exigences techniques, architectures système et plans de validation.
* Identifier les dépendances techniques, contraintes d-interface et risques d-intégration entre les systèmes matériels et logiciels.
* Veiller à ce que les solutions répondent aux contraintes de la Formule 1, notamment en termes d-empaquetage, poids, aérodynamique, refroidissement, latence, fiabilité et sécurité du pilote.
Gestion des fournisseurs et des parties prenantes
* Identifier et coordonner les fournisseurs technologiques spécialisés, partenaires d-ingénierie et organisations de recherche.
* Examiner et challenger les propositions des fournisseurs, architectures techniques, résultats de tests, coûts et délais de livraison.
* Créer un alignement entre les équipes de Formule 1, les départements techniques de la FIA, les spécialistes de la sécurité et les partenaires externes.
* Diriger des ateliers techniques, concilier les exigences concurrentes et faciliter des compromis pragmatiques.
Tests, facteurs humains et gestion des risques
* Coordonner la simulation, l-évaluation en laboratoire, le développement de prototypes et les tests sur véhicule.
* Développer des protocoles de validation pour les technologies individuelles et les solutions intégrées.
* Évaluer les facteurs humains, y compris la charge cognitive, l-ergonomie visuelle, la priorisation de l-information, la latence et l-évacuation d-urgence du pilote.
* Identifier et atténuer les risques techniques, de sécurité, financiers, de propriété intellectuelle et de livraison du programme.
Réglementation et feuille de route stratégique
* Évaluer les implications potentielles pour les règlements techniques, sportifs et financiers de la FIA.
* Soutenir le développement des feuilles de route réglementaires, de normalisation et de mise en œuvre.
* Préparer des analyses techniques de compromis, des recommandations et des scénarios de mise en œuvre par phases.
* Consolider les résultats techniques et les résultats des tests en rapports clairs pour la direction et les instances de gouvernance.

* Solides connaissances techniques dans des domaines tels que l-électronique embarquée, les systèmes de contrôle, les capteurs, les systèmes de communication, la fusion de capteurs, les technologies de positionnement, les systèmes embarqués ou les affichages optiques.

* Expérience dans l-intégration de composants matériels et logiciels dans des environnements exigeants, haute performance ou critiques pour la sécurité.

* Une expérience avec les technologies HUD, les systèmes de casque, la fusion de capteurs, le positionnement des véhicules ou les technologies d-assistance au pilote serait un avantage.
